author: Andrew Fader
description: A threaded MITM forward proxy for Capybara/Cuprite system tests. It re-issues each browser request through Excon, so VCR and WebMock see browser traffic (an OAuth login, a third-party widget, a presigned S3 fetch) the same way they see server traffic. No EventMachine, one certificate for every host.
